description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'OpenApiConfig' responsible for customizing the OpenAPI documentation and setting up a filter handling forwarded headers. It provides beans to support proper URL generation in API documentation and in environments behind proxies.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for customizing OpenAPI documentation and proxy header handling.

methods.name: forwardedHeaderFilter
methods.description: Creates and registers a ForwardedHeaderFilter bean to ensure correct handling of X-Forwarded-* headers for URL reconstruction.

methods.name: serverOpenApiCustomiser
methods.description: Creates an OpenApiCustomiser bean that sets the server URL to a relative path based on the servlet context path, aiding in accurate API URL generation in different environments.
